streaming.title: Streaming
streaming.description: Configuration of the HLS segment format and size. Affects startup speed and quality switching.
streaming.auto_quality_mode_help: Defines what the "Auto" quality does. Explicit quality choices are not affected: "Original" stays in Direct Play if the device is compatible.
streaming.auto_quality_mode_directplay_help: In "Auto", the server sends the original file without transcoding when the device is compatible: near-zero server load. Downside: no automatic bitrate adaptation, on a slow connection, manually choose a lower quality.
streaming.auto_quality_mode_abr_help: In "Auto", the server transcodes to adaptive HLS that adjusts quality to the network bitrate in real time. Downside: every "Auto" playback uses transcoding (CPU/GPU), reserve it for servers with hardware acceleration.
streaming.segment_duration_help: Shorter segments = faster startup but more HTTP requests. 3s is a good compromise.
streaming.throttle_enabled_help: Pauses encoding once it gets far ahead of playback and resumes as the viewer catches up. Saves CPU on stops and seeks.
streaming.throttle_unavailable_help: Not available on this server: it can't pause an encoder mid-run.
streaming.throttle_threshold_help: How far ahead of playback the encoder may get before it pauses, in seconds. Resumes at half this value.
streaming.auto_crop: Allow transcoding to remove black bars
streaming.auto_crop_help: Players that crop by themselves receive the original stream, the others a re-encoded version. To remove the bars from the file for good, use an optimization profile.
streaming.init_time_help: The first segment can be shorter to speed up startup. The following ones use the normal duration.
streaming.qsv_preset_help: From veryfast to veryslow: speed against quality. No effect on VAAPI or NVENC.
streaming.ffmpeg_slots_help: Parallel ffmpeg processes for scans, thumbnails and markers. Empty = derived from the CPU cores.
streaming.tonemap_algo_help: Which filter converts HDR to SDR. Auto suits most hosts; the other options exist for when the image comes out too dark.
streaming.tonemap_curve_help: Shape of the highlight compression. Ignored by vpp_qsv and tonemap_vaapi, which convert in fixed hardware.
streaming.gpu_device_help: Which GPU handles hardware transcoding on a multi-GPU host.
streaming.cache_max_gb_help: Disk budget for transcoded segments. Past it, the least recently played go first.
streaming.cache_ttl_hours_help: How long a cached title survives without being played.
streaming.cache_purge_help: Frees disk space now. Playbacks in progress retranscode on the fly.
streaming.cache_purge_confirm: This deletes all cached transcoded segments. Playbacks in progress will retranscode on the fly (brief rebuffering). Continue?

CUDA and MIGraphX need the whole lib/ directory of one ONNX Runtime release mounted on the host and ORT_DYLIB_PATH pointing at its libonnxruntime.so. CUDA also needs cudart, cufft, curand, cuDNN 9 and cuBLAS of the build's CUDA version on LD_LIBRARY_PATH and a recent enough driver. MIGraphX needs ROCm and MIGraphX libraries, the devices /dev/kfd and /dev/dri and the video and render groups, and Microsoft publishes no MIGraphX build: build or extract one yourself. The GPU is the first one; choose another with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES or HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES. On Windows, DirectML and the vendor providers come with the Windows ML runtime.
